title: Te Whakamātautau i raro i ngā Ngaru
intro: I whakatau tetahi poropiti, i taimaha i tana misioni, i arahi i a ia ki tawhiti atu i tōna iwi, ā, i uru atu ki tētahi whakamātautau ohorere. I tino rerekē tana haerenga, i whakamatautauria tōna whakapono me tōna manawanui i te huarahi tino hohonu. Ka taea e koe te whakatau i ngā taipitopito o tēnei huihuinga whakamiharo mai i ngā tohu i whakaratohia?
clues: I tonoa tētahi poropiti ki tētahi iwi, engari i hohoro tonu tana haere atu, i te pōuri mō tō rātou whakakahoretia.
Nā tana haerenga ia i arahi ki te moana, ā, ka eke ia ki runga i tētahi kaipuke taumaha e rapu huarahi ana.
Ka puta he tupuhi nui, ka whakawehi i te kaipuke, ā, ka whakatauhia kia maka tetahi tangata ki te moana hei whakamama i te utanga, i whakatauhia mā te rota.
I horomia ia e tetahi mea hanga o te hohonu, he merekara i whakaritea e te Atua.
I roto i te puku o te mea hanga, ka karanga ia ki tōna Ariki, me te ripeneta me te whakakororia i a Allah i roto i te pōuri.
I muri i tētahi wā o te inoi kaha, ka maka ia ki te takutai waikore, he ngoikore engari e ora ana; ā, i muri mai ka hoki ia ka kite kua whakapono tōna iwi.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te haerenga i roto i te puku o te ika nui
Te whakakitenga mai o te rakau e mura ana
trial.answer: Te haerenga i roto i te puku o te ika nui

outcome.label: Hua
options: He kawenata hou ki te tangata
He whānautanga merekara mō tōna iwi
He kingitanga i whakatūria mō tōna whakapapa
He hokinga ki tōna iwi i whakapono i taua wā
He wikitoria i runga i tētahi rangatira nanakia
outcome.answer: He hokinga ki tōna iwi i whakapono i taua wā

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
